crossRefs.note: After three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the middle of the teachers, both listening to them, and…
People went out to see what had happened. They came to Jesus and found the man from whom the demons had gone out…
Yes, he loves the people. All his saints are in your hand. They sat down at your feet. Each receives your words.
Blessed is the man who hears me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at my door posts.
“I am indeed a Jew, born in Tarsus of Cilicia, but brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, instructed…
But I desire to have you to be free from cares. He who is unmarried is concerned for the things of the Lord, how he may…
